# Eidos Design System

> Eidos is the design system that powers Equifax/Boa Vista's internal developer platform. It's CSS-first (Tailwind v4 + token CSS variables), framework-agnostic at the class layer, and ships React reference components meant to be copy-pasted into product code. There is no npm package to install — own your copy of every component.

## Principles

- One accent: ember (#FF6B35). Use at most twice per screen.
- Compose existing classes and components. Never reinvent something that already lives in tokens.css / ds.css.
- Logical CSS properties everywhere (inset-inline-*, padding-inline-*, margin-inline-*). RTL is a first-class requirement, not an after-thought.
- Tokens live in tokens.css; component classes live in ds.css. No per-page <style> blocks.
- React core is split: atoms.jsx → primitives.jsx → blocks.jsx → charts.jsx → shell.jsx. Load in that order; each IIFE exports to window.

## Files an LLM should read first

- /CLAUDE.md — TL;DR authoring rules (read on every session start).
- /EIDOS-DS-REFERENCE.md — long-form catalog (tokens, every CSS class, every React component, every icon, every page). ~920 lines.
- /forge-design-system/assets/js/core/nav-config.js — single source of truth for navigation, slugs, and labels.
- /forge-design-system/assets/css/tokens.css — every design token (colors, type, spacing, radius, shadow, motion).
- /forge-design-system/assets/css/ds.css — every component class (.btn, .pill, .surface, .in-*, .fc-*, .cb-*, .menu, .tt, .ds-frame, .ds-grid, …).

- [Introduction](design-system.html): What Eidos is, who maintains it, how it ships.
- [Installation](pages/get-started/installation.html): Tailwind v4 preset + React copy-paste workflow. No npm install.
- [Components catalog](pages/get-started/components.html): Searchable grid of every component with previews.

## Foundations

- [Brand](pages/foundations/brand.html): Flame mark, lockups, brand color rules, do/don't on logo usage.
- [Color](pages/foundations/color.html): Surface, foreground, ember, ice, violet, status palettes with usage matrix.
- [Severity & state](pages/foundations/severity.html): Mapping of info/success/warning/danger/critical onto tokens and pills.
- [Typography](pages/foundations/typography.html): Geist sans + Geist Mono, display-xl through mono-label scale.
- [Spacing & Radius](pages/foundations/spacing.html): 4px base scale; radius xs (3px) through 2xl (12px).
- [Shadows & Borders](pages/foundations/shadows.html): Elevation 1/2/3 + alpha border tokens.
- [Iconography](pages/foundations/iconography.html): 95+ icons in window.Icons, 12–20px sizes, 1.5px stroke, currentColor.
- [Motion](pages/foundations/motion.html): cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) — durations fast (120ms), normal (220ms), slow (360ms).

## Components — Form & Input

- [AI Label](pages/components/ai-label.html): Pill marking AI-generated content with shimmer accent.
- [Button](pages/components/buttons.html): .btn — primary, ghost, ember variants; sizes sm / md / lg.
- [Button Group](pages/components/button-group.html): Segmented control of attached buttons.
- [Calendar](pages/components/calendar.html): Single-month grid; basis of Date Picker.
- [Checkbox](pages/components/checkbox.html): .fc-check chrome over an opacity-0 real input. Wrap label, don't htmlFor.
- [Color Input](pages/components/color-input.html): Hex/RGB picker with swatch preview.
- [Combobox](pages/components/combobox.html): .cb-* — fixed-positioned panel with search filter.
- [Date Picker](pages/components/date-picker.html): Input + calendar popover; supports single + range.
- [File Input](pages/components/file-input.html): Drop zone + chooser with file list and per-row remove.
- [Form composition](pages/components/forms.html): Full label + control + helper + error patterns.
- [Input](pages/components/input.html): .in-control sits inside .in-group; focus ring lives on the group.
- [Input Group](pages/components/input-group.html): Left/right addons — icon, text, button, select, spinner, stepper.
- [Label](pages/components/label.html): Semantic label tied to a control via id/htmlFor.
- [Number Input](pages/components/number-input.html): Input with stepper addon.
- [OTP Input](pages/components/otp-input.html): 4–8 digit one-time-passcode boxes.
- [Pills & Chips](pages/components/pills.html): .pill (status) and .chip (selectable).
- [Radio Group](pages/components/radio.html): .fc-radio chrome; exclusive selection.
- [Select](pages/components/select.html): Native + custom Select with .sel-search panel.
- [Slider](pages/components/slider.html): Single value + range with two thumbs.
- [Switch](pages/components/switch.html): .fc-toggle; thumb uses spring cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1).
- [Tag Input](pages/components/tag-input.html): Comma / Enter–separated tags with backspace removal.
- [Textarea](pages/components/textarea.html): Multi-line input with optional auto-grow.
- [Toolbar](pages/components/toolbar.html): Horizontal action bar with dividers + icon buttons.

- [Tooltip](pages/components/tooltips.html): [data-tt="…"] attribute works on any element; no JS hookup needed.

## Charts

Recharts wrappers themed with Forge tokens — viz palette lives in tokens.css. Use only for data visualization; not for layout decoration.

- [Overview](pages/charts/overview.html): Palette, color order, and shared options for every chart.
- [Area chart](pages/charts/area.html): Filled time-series; supports stacked.
- [Bar chart](pages/charts/bar.html): Vertical / horizontal categorical bars.
- [Composed chart](pages/charts/composed.html): Bar + line + area combined on one axis.
- [Gauge chart](pages/charts/gauge.html): Half-ring percentage gauge.
- [Heatmap](pages/charts/heatmap.html): 2D matrix with intensity coloring.
- [Histogram](pages/charts/histogram.html): Distribution buckets.
- [Line chart](pages/charts/line.html): Time-series single / multi-series.
- [Pie chart](pages/charts/pie.html): Categorical share-of-total.
- [Radar chart](pages/charts/radar.html): Multi-axis polar plot.
- [Radial chart](pages/charts/radial.html): Concentric percent rings.
- [Sankey diagram](pages/charts/sankey.html): Flow between categories.

Surfaces a Eidos product needs once it's wired to a model. Every page composes existing components (pill, btn, in-group, collapsible, surface) — no new primitives.

- [Conversation](pages/ai/conversation.html): Full thread layout — header, scroll area, composer.
- [Errors](pages/ai/errors.html): Model error states (rate limit, timeout, refusal).

- [Message](pages/ai/message.html): Single message bubble (user / assistant / system).
- [Prompt Input](pages/ai/prompt-input.html): Multi-line composer with attachments + actions.
- [Reasoning](pages/ai/reasoning.html): Collapsible thinking-trace block.
- [Response](pages/ai/response.html): Assistant response with copy / regenerate / feedback actions.
- [Suggestion](pages/ai/suggestion.html): Clickable prompt-suggestion chip.
- [Tool](pages/ai/tool.html): Tool-call display — input, output, status, duration.

## Rules for code generation

1. Read this file + EIDOS-DS-REFERENCE.md before writing any new page. Skipping that step produces drift from the system.
2. Compose. If something can be built from Pill + Card + Avatar + Trend, build it that way — don't invent a new class.
3. Never write a per-page <style> block. Use existing classes (.btn, .surface, .ds-frame, .ds-grid, .in-*, .fc-*, .cb-*, .menu, .tt, .pill, .chip, .badge, .avatar, .tbl) or extend tokens.css / ds.css.
4. Every component page must include: live demo Frame, Anatomy, Decision matrix, Do/Don't with live UI demos (not just text), and an RTL example. See buttons.jsx as the canonical template.
5. Spacing rhythm: caption after Frame uses marginTop: 14 (positive). Lede after SubHead uses marginTop: -6 (negative — attaches lede to its heading; intentional). Consecutive Frames separate with .ds-frame + .ds-frame { margin-top: 18px }.
6. RTL: logical properties everywhere (inset-inline-*, padding-inline-*, margin-inline-*, border-inline-*, text-align: start). The only physical-property exception is transform: translateX(…) — that needs a [dir="rtl"] override.
7. Adding a new page requires three coordinated changes: (1) append { id, label, href } in nav-config.js; (2) create pages/<group>/<slug>.html from pages/_template.html; (3) create assets/js/pages/<group>/<slug>.jsx registering window.PAGES['<slug>'].
8. Version bumps happen in two places at once: sidebar sub-text and topbar badge in shell.jsx. They must always stay in sync. Bump cache-busting query strings via forge-design-system/scripts/bump-version.sh.
9. React + Babel are pinned (react@18.3.1, react-dom@18.3.1, @babel/standalone@7.29.0). Each <script type="text/babel"> has its own scope — share components via Object.assign(window, { … }) at the end of each IIFE.
10. Common gotchas: black screen → missing Icons.x reference or syntax error in the page JSX (check boot.jsx's diagnostic). Doubled focus ring → suppress on inner inputs with box-shadow: none !important. Dropdown clipped → .ds-frame has overflow: hidden; use position: fixed + getBoundingClientRect() to escape.
